name: Ice Spike
primary:
An ice spike grows from your feet where you look: up for a pillar, forward for a ram, at an angle for a ramp.
A spike of up to 12 blocks bursts out of the surface at the aim point with a random tilt and side shards, stopping at obstacles; aimed at the sky, it grows from your feet along your view. Material: ice, melts after 30 s.
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 11 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
